note: Fuzz harness passes the ini buffer (with last byte as type) to parse_jobs_ini.
The line 'description=$ncpusA' is read from the ini buffer and stored as an option string.
The collected options are passed to fio_options_parse for keyword substitution.
fio_options_parse calls dup_and_sub_options which performs keyword substitution.
The option string 'description=$ncpusA' is passed to fio_keyword_replace.
The keyword '$ncpus' is found at offset 12 of the option string, followed by a trailing 'A'.
opt is advanced past the keyword to point at the trailing 'A' (strlen(opt)=1), so the guarded memcpy executes.

code: memcpy(new + olen + len, opt, opt - o_org - 1);
note: memcpy reads (opt - o_org - 1) = strlen(kw->word)+olen-1 = 17 bytes from opt, but only strlen(opt)=1 byte plus NUL remain in the heap buffer, causing a heap-buffer-overflow read.
invariant: memcpy read length must not exceed remaining source buffer length
